from cyhole.birdeye import Birdeye

# Instantiate Birdeye interaction (uses BIRDEYE_API_KEY env var by default)
birdeye = Birdeye()

# Example Solana token address (Raydium)
token_address = "4k3Dyjzvzp8eMZWUXbBCjEvwSkkk59S5iCNLY3QrkX4r"

# Fetch current price synchronously
response = birdeye.client.get_price(address=token_address)

# Access the price data
print(f"Price: ${response.data.value}")
print(f"Token: {response.data.address}")
print(f"Updated: {response.data.update_human_time}")
